assay: MeRIP-seq (m6A IP) plus input RNA-seq of mouse heart; the input libraries are the mRNA-expression arm (S2.7.p1, S2.8.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of 8 weeks moderate treadmill exercise on heart mRNA expression in two-hit (HFD + L-NAME) HFpEF mice: HFpEF+EXT vs sedentary HFpEF
sample_inclusion: n = 3 male C57BL/6J HFpEF and 3 HFpEF+EXT hearts for RNA-seq (S2.8.p1, S3.4.p1 'n = 3 per group'); IP libraries are the m6A arm, not expression
planned_contrasts: HFpEF+EXT vs HFpEF (S3.4.p1; paper: 690 DEGs, 267 up, 423 down)
normalization: featureCounts then DESeq2 (S2.8.p1); FPKM shown in Fig 3A
paper_method: DESeq2 on featureCounts counts, two groups (S2.8.p1)
paper_results: 690 DEGs (267 up, 423 down) HFpEF+EXT vs HFpEF; Table 3 mRNA log2FC: Casp12 -1.27, Capn2 -0.31, Fas -1.03, Casp7 -0.54, Jun -0.99, Pdia3 -0.50, Tnnt2 +0.73, Mef2a +0.44, Adrb1 +0.53, Agtr1a +0.53
